title: A browser tool tests whether funding would speed up a repeatable customer motion
summary: The seed and early-capital readiness tool gives a verdict on whether money would accelerate a repeatable customer motion or only extend the search for one.
text: If you are a founder deciding whether to raise, answer the gate questions and the tool returns a verdict from deterministic rules, not a score. It runs in your browser, with nothing sent unless you choose to share it. You can also switch it to challenge mode, copy an AI prompt that stress-tests your answers, and download a decision record. A companion section lists the common traps that make a raise look ready when it isn't.
